## What
Fixed the comment 'is the the small we want to use' in the Cohere ASR processor. It now reads 'is the small value we want to use'.

## Why
A small, objectively-verifiable improvement (typo) found during a
daily open-source maintenance pass (2026-10-09).

## How verified
Found the duplicated word with a regex search across docs, vllm and examples. Read the surrounding lines to confirm the comment was missing a noun. git diff shows 1 line changed in 1 file, the working tree is clean, and the commit is on branch aarush/fix-cohere-asr-comment-typo. It is a comment-only change, so no tests were run.
Automated gates: 2 changed lines across 1 files (within limits); cargo check: not needed.

---
Prepared with Claude Code assistance and reviewed by Aarush's
automation gates (diff-size, file-scope, deletion, and build checks)
before opening.
